premises.text: America has massive car overpopulation with hundreds of millions of cars parked most of the day
premises.evidence_span: We have over 250 million cars in America that sit parked 22 hours each day

premises.text: GetAround is a peer-to-peer car-sharing marketplace where nearby owners set price/availability and renters book via an iPhone app with ratings and in-app keys
premises.evidence_span: Getaround is a marketplace for peer-to-peer car sharing, the Airbnb for cars

premises.text: A low-cost self-install Car Kit with keyless remote, Wi-Fi, and GPS enables smartphone-only secure car access
premises.evidence_span: a beautiful, low-cost, and easy-to-install device that combines a keyless remote with Wi-Fi and GPS

premises.text: GetAround provides insurance with each rental via a Berkshire Hathaway deal enabling national coverage expansion
premises.evidence_span: Getaround provides insurance as part of each rental

premises.text: The peer-to-peer model is not limited to dense urban areas like Zipcar and takes a commission on rentals
premises.evidence_span: The peer-to-peer model is not limited to dense urban areas like Zipcar

domains.name: P2P marketplace and iPhone rental UX

value.text: People rent cars instantly nearby and owners earn money, redefining ownership and reducing car overpopulation
value.evidence_span: Instead of buying a car, you can rent one instantly from someone nearby

secondary_value.text: Large-scale sharing would cut CO2 emissions dramatically
secondary_value.evidence_span: CO2 emissions would drop by a whopping 48 billion pounds per year

causal_links.evidence_span: solving a problem we call car overpopulation
rent one instantly from someone nearby
